instruction: Classify these Prometheus metrics as gauge or counter: node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, container_cpu_usage_seconds_total, process_resident_memory_bytes, node_network_receive_bytes_total
output:
node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes: gauge (value goes up and down with no monotonic increase)
container_cpu_usage_seconds_total: counter (monotonically increases, use rate)
process_resident_memory_bytes: gauge (current RSS sample)
node_network_receive_bytes_total: counter (cumulative bytes, use rate)
